subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of variable costs ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rent.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rent** is a **fixed cost **as it remains **constant **regardless of the level of production or sales.
 
• It is a cost that is incurred regularly and **does not vary** with the quantity produced or sold.
 
• Examples of other fixed costs include **salaries, insurance, and property taxes.**
 
• Fixed costs are important to consider when calculating the **breakeven point** for a business.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Distribution costs** can be** variable or fixed**, depending on the method of distribution.

 
 
• If a company uses a **third-party logistics** provider, the cost may be **variable** based on the volume of goods shipped.
 
• If a company has its own distribution network, the cost may be** fixed** as it is a regular expense.
 
• Other variable costs in distribution may include **fuel costs and transportation expenses.**
 
 
 
• **Packaging costs** can be **variable or fixed**, depending on the type of packaging used.
 
 
• If a company uses custom packaging for each product, the cost may be** variable** based on the quantity produced.
 
• If a company uses standard packaging for all products, the cost may be** fixed **as it is a regular expense.
 
• Other variable costs in packaging may include **materials and labor costs.**
 
 
 
• **Raw material costs** are typically considered **variable costs** as they vary with the quantity produced.
 
 
• The cost of raw materials may fluctuate based on **supply and demand, weather conditions**, and other factors.
 
• It is important for companies to **monitor raw material costs **and adjust pricing or production levels accordingly.
 
• Other variable costs in production may include **labor costs and energy costs.**
